title: Dynamic fluctuations of emotional states in adolescents with delayed sleep phase—A longitudinal network modeling approach
limitations: - DSP was based on only one diagnostic criterion; - DSP was assessed only once; - Limited number of observations per participant; - Potential selection bias due to drop-out; - Data collected during school year only
notes: The paper does not explicitly state preregistration status, but the study was registered under Clinical Trials (ID: 1287174). Code and data are declared available in supplementary materials.
